source_snapshot.procedure: Install 64GB x4 DIMMs, enable ADDDC and run placeholder DeviceSparingHarasser recipe with fixed adjacent/debug/self-check options.
source_snapshot.criteria: Normal operation, correctable slot records, both lights off, applicable UEFI and `sparing_harasser PASSED`.
source_snapshot.deepseek: NO; generic evidence cannot prove Advanced Rank or no-plus1.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION; rank topology and exact Advanced/no-plus1 recipe required.

old_problem: The common call did not expose a rank selector or resolved Advanced-RAS/no-plus1 values, and the x4 rank population, coverage, health oracle and restoration were unbound.
disposition_reason: The rank-granularity/no-plus1 variant and PASSED/slot/no-light outcome are explicit. ED-03 allows the vendor recipe's adddcType, plus1-disabled, target/rank mapping and duration as runtime bindings; ED-09/16 keep hardware and injection operator-controlled. Execution is refused unless the package proves rank mode, so the review is complete without copying Bank/plus1 recipes.
decision_basis: Directly read XLSX Reliability rows 24 and 25 plus same-row DeepSeek fields.
Read historical record 2429 and preserved identity/hashes.
Keep Advanced Rank without plus1 independent from Bank and all plus1 variants.
Require vendor evidence that resolved adddcType/target actually selects rank-level sparing; Items text alone is not execution proof.
Preserve adjacent=True, debug=False, skipSelfCheck=False and full PASSED transcript.
No DIMM, BIOS, harasser, retry or DUT action occurred.

test_case.test_name: Advanced-RAS rank ADDDC sparing without plus1
test_case.purpose: Exercise Advanced-RAS ADDDC at rank granularity with plus1 disabled on approved x4 topology and prove PASSED, rank/slot attribution, normal health and both indicators off.
required_package: Approved 64GB x4 DIMM PN/slot/rank topology and ESD procedure
Intel package build/hash and rank-mode/no-plus1 recipe contract
test_case.test_command: After qualified x4 installation and trained rank-map verification, an FAE runs `ras.DeviceSparingHarasser(...)` once per signed rank target using the exact Advanced-RAS rank/no-plus1 recipe while retaining `adjacent=True, debug=False, skipSelfCheck=False`. Capture the full mode/target proof and PASSED transcript, correlated slot/rank records, health and both no-light states, then restore baseline.
test_case.expected_result: Every approved rank target completes the correct Advanced-RAS/no-plus1 path with `sparing_harasser PASSED`; correctable evidence maps to the intended rank/slot, health remains normal, lights remain off, applicable UEFI agrees and baseline is restored.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires verified rank topology, vendor-proven rank-mode/no-plus1 recipe, full target coverage/PASSED evidence, correct rank/slot, health, no-light proof and restoration. Bank/Standard/plus1 substitution, guessed values, generic CE, wrong target, UCE, lamp or instability is not PASS.
safety_gate: Powered-down ESD DIMM handling and qualified operator/FAE.
Verify trained rank topology and complete recipe before one target.
Stop on wrong rank/mode, self-check failure, UCE, lamp, crash or degraded health.
No automatic retry or next target before evidence/recovery.
expected_evidence: Row/variant/hash and x4 DIMM/rank installation map
Package hash and vendor proof of rank/no-plus1 parameterization
Complete target coverage and PASSED transcript
test_case.recovery: Preserve evidence and stop on anomaly. Qualified operators restore physical population and BIOS/ADDDC state and verify rank topology/memory health before separate rerun.
